[h2]Graphical Updates[/h2]

[*] Outlines Shader added - can be disabled in settings

[*] Coop Mode - Slow Motion menu option now respected

[list]
[*] Sprint + Grab is now a Universal Burst
[*] Can be used during hit stun
[*] Uses one-third meter
[/list]

[h2]Guard Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can no longer cancel into guard at any point during attacks
[/list]

[h2]Movement Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Air Dash - Minimum Jump Height requirement added
[/list]

[h2]Attack Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-introduced attack auto rotating nearest opponent, We might limit auto rotate within  a certain range of degrees
[*] Universal Uppercut no longer uses meter, removed circle effect
[*] Sprint Attack no longer uses meter, removed circle effect
[*] Element effects added to charged melee attacks
[*] CIrcle effect removed on Enemy attack indicator
[/list]

[h2]Throw Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Circle effect added to grab attempts, color corresponds to the target
[/list]

[h2]Cosmetic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trench coat/Detective costumes added to the 8 main characters
[*] The game build crashed the first time I tried loading a trench coat costume, but then I wasn't able to replicate it. Anyone else having this experience? Please message in the Discord.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
Happy to announce that I am working with [url=https://linkin.bio/techchasetv/]TechChaseTV[/url] as my Combat Designer for 'Urban Warriors'. I met him at the Defend The North X fighting game tournament and we sat together for a day and a half taking notes and implementing as many changes as we could. With his encyclopedic knowledge of frame data, I consider him a 'fighting game genius'. The goal is to build the most exhilarating competitive arena fighting game by raising the skill ceiling & enabling player expression. We've put together a long list of refinements & implementations. This is the first of many gameplay updates in the coming weeks.

[h2]Slow Motion & Parry Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Versus Mode - Slow Motion during Special Moves & Parries have been disabled.
[*] Versus Mode - Slow Motion "SlowMo" Option added. Consider enabling for casual/party mode.
[*] Parry Window reduced to 5 frames, "SlowMo" if enabled, can make the perception of these frames to be longer because of time dilation.
[/list]

[h2]Universal Launcher Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sprint + Punch is now a Universal Launcher
[*] The startup frames are shorter after a punch attack
[/list]

[h2]Guard Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Guard no longer auto rotates nearest opponent, We might re-introduce auto rotate within a certain range of degrees
[*] Air Guard no longer has animation transitions
[/list]

[h2]Movement Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dash No longer requires meter
[*] Dash No longer has invincibility frames
[*] Air Dash Distance Reduced
[*] Velocity is now preserved on landing
[*] Friction reduced to allow some sliding
[*] Jump Gravity decreased
[*] Second Jump Velocity decreased
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900620/d9e5377316b542f443f071cb0a129fc82f63647e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Throw Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Throws can now be Teched by pressing the Grab button
[*] Throws now beat Guard
[*] Throw animation updated with new timing
[*] Successful Throw attempt leads to Special Throw paired attacks
[*] Special Throws currently beat Guard & cannot be Teched. We will re-evaluate Special Throws
[*] Versus Mode - CPU Opponents now attempt Throws & Pickup Nearby Weapons/Props
[/list]
